Lami: A Cup of Code & Coffee

name: Lami: A Cup of Code & Coffee
storyline: Lami: A Cup of Code & Coffee is a 3D casual game that blends Japanese aesthetics with café & workshop management, and rhythm gameplay. The story follows a young protagonist who, feeling disenchanted with their mundane life, receives a letter from their late grandfather asking them to take over his café. Intrigued, the protagonist quits their job and heads to the café, only to discover a hidden research lab on the upper floor, where an AI robot girl named Lami awakens. It turns out that Lami was developed by the protagonist’s grandfather, and now, together with Lami, they embark on a new life managing the café. What challenges await them?
summary: Inheriting Grandpa’s Old Café… and Meeting a Cute Robot Girl?! Use all your skills to develop unique gadgets and run the café alongside the adorable Lami. Face exciting challenges and gradually uncover Lami’s story!
